answer: Put cross-chain identity proof via Meson at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 504 pays 8064 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The jade of the design is public, the ledge of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the signal of honest work is what finally pays. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
